notes.title: v1.2 Chinese translation and improved gamepad support
notes.content:
I've updated input system and added Chinese translation. Now game can be used with steam big picture mode and it supports more than 50 gamepads. Full list of supported gamepads can be found [url=http://guavaman.com/projects/rewired/docs/SupportedControllers.html]here[/url]. 


[h1]Changelog:[/h1]
- Game now supports more than 50 gamepads.
- Game is now playable in steam big picture mode.
- Chinese translation added to the game.
- faceplus.dll removed, cause some antiviruses didn't liked that file.
- Now both sticks and d-pad can be used to navigate menus with gamepad.
- Player can now skip intro screens.
- Input menu received partial Russian, French, Chinese translation.
- Texture quality of loading screens improved.

notes.title: v1.10 - Small patch
notes.content:
Hey Everyone,

This is just a small patch. It mainly addresses problem with a low default music volume.

[h1][b]Version 1.10 Changelog:[/b][/h1]
[list]
    [*]Default music volume is set to 100%.
    [*]You can now rebind crouch key.
    [*]I've removed annoying sound when player is walking on wooden surfaces.
[/list]

If you're interested in my games. Here's my next horror game
http://store.steampowered.com/app/359940/

notes.title: v1.00 - Game is released
notes.content:
Hey Everyone,

Game is finally out of early access. It's a small update that fixes couple small issues. There's also good news for Mac users. Mac version of game is updated to the latest version that includes all those improvements that are available to windows users.

[h1][b]Version 1.00 Changelog:[/b][/h1]
[list]
    [*]Credits window now opens.
    [*]Some materials on sewer level replaced with less demanding materials.
    [*]Issue that prevented game on Mac to be launched is resolved.
[/list]

If you're interested in my games. Here's my next horror game
http://store.steampowered.com/app/359940/

tags.bug: [*]Some materials on sewer level replaced with less demanding materials.
[*]Issue that prevented game on Mac to be launched is resolved.

notes.title: v0.91 - Key Bindings menu
notes.content:
Hey Everyone,

I've added menu that allows player to change controls for keyboard, mouse and gamepad. Because I've wanted to add that option as soon as possible, this menu in not yet translated to all languages and in game tips do not reflect controls changes made in this menu.

[h1][b]Version 0.91 Changelog:[/b][/h1]
[list]
    [*]Added Key Bindings menu 
    [*]Small bug fixes
[/list]

notes.title: v0.80 - Additional graphics options
notes.content:
Hey Everyone,

I've added additional graphics options to options menu and added controls menu item, that describes controls for keyboard and gamepad.

[h1][b]Version 0.80 Changelog:[/b][/h1]
[list]
    [*]Added ability to set Texture Quality.
    [*]Added ability to set Anisotropic Filtering.
    [*]Added option to turn on/off Vertical Synchronization.
    [*]Options menu, now shows current anti aliasing level.
    [*]Added description of keyboard controls scheme. (not localized)
    [*]Controls related options and information moved to controls menu.
    [*]Anti-Aliasing for Maximum quality setting increased to 8x. 
[/list]

notes.title: v0.50 - Gamepad support and new menu
notes.content:
Hey Everyone,

This update features new main menu that supports gamepad input. This means, that you can use gamepad to play Gynophobia from start to finish, without a need to reach for mouse or kayboard. I've also included "invert Y axis" option that works with mouse and gamepad.

[h1][b]Version 0.50 Changelog:[/b][/h1]
[list]
    [*]New menu, that supports gamepad input
    [*]Gamepad controls hint, located in options
    [*]Invert Y axis option
[/list]

[img]http://creashock-studios.com/xlam/gyno_menu.jpg[/img]

tags.feature: New menu, that supports gamepad input
Gamepad controls hint, located in options
Invert Y axis option
